![formula](264,361,628,411) $R \bowtie_c S = \delta_c (R \times S)$

![text](314,414,875,448) $\rightarrow c$ is called a JOIN condition

![text](314,461,552,529) — usually using full constraint.

![text](684,448,924,544) $\rightarrow$ can only have attribute name

![text](648,540,890,642) *this is different from SELECTION condition*

![text](53,694,837,787) — there should be fewer tuples in JOIN compared to PRODUCT
